sources.summary: The design of the exhibition 'Masterpieces from the Lanckoroński Collection: A Story of Antiquity' is an attempt to introduce unconventional, modern display methods into the historic architecture of Wawel. The concept is based on a stylistically cohesive arrangement of all the rooms, consistent in form but varied in the selection of colours and materials. This, in turn, creates an element of surprise and a gradual progression of impressions.
